title: Discrete energy balance of the coupled Boussinesq solution (v = 1): variational Dirichlet flux + natural outflow - int Q + int rho0 c_p u_h.grad T_h = 0 (planar and axisymmetric, lap/sym, Galerkin/SUPG)
physics: rho0 (u.grad)u - div sigma_form = f_u + rho0 beta g (T - T_ref) e_up, div u = 0, rho0 c_p u.grad T - div(k grad T) = Q

unit.construction: scalar_transport_check.box_mesh(8, 8, k), k = 0..4, on [0,1]^2 in (x, y): 8 x 8 squares split along the (1,1) diagonal except the two cells at the corners (1,0) and (0,1) (split the other way: no triangle with all vertices on the boundary), refined uniformly (red) k times (identical to the fixed F1a structured_mesh(N), N = 8 * 2^k). Nested.
unit.h_definition: h_nominal = 1/N (leg of the right triangles); h_max = sqrt(2)/N reported too

parameters.dirichlet_data: P2 (P1) Lagrange NODAL interpolation of the fixed callables at the vertices and edge midpoints of the Dirichlet boundary parts; at a node shared by two Dirichlet parts the data agree (one exact callable per field); Dirichlet beats every natural condition at a shared node
parameters.flux_definition: q_D = -R. w over the UNION of the Dirichlet temperature parts; natural_out by the check module from the fixed Robin / Neumann data and T_h
